name: flowviewer
author: Alexey Kucherenko
description: A platform for real-time visualization, monitoring, and analysis of nextflow pipeline execution.

scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @flowviewer/frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @flowviewer/backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @flowviewer/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @flowviewer/backend
